name: LCModel
author: Stephen Provencher
description: MR spectrosocpy signal quantification software. More details available on https://s-provencher.com/lcmodel.shtml
command-line: unzip -j [ZIP_BASIS] -d basis && bash /run_lcmodel.sh [CTRL_FILE] [SIGNAL_FILE] basis [OUTNAME] && tar -czvf [OUTNAME].tar.gz [OUTNAME]_* && rm -rf basis

inputs.name: Signal file
inputs.description: Text file with extension '.RAW' containing the signal to quantify

inputs.name: Control file
inputs.description: Text file with extension '.control' setting up constraints, options and prior knowledge used in LCModel algorithm

inputs.name: Zipped data base folder
inputs.description: Archive containing all metabolite & macromolecules in .RAW format

inputs.name: outname
inputs.description: Prefix name of the output files

output-files.description: A zipped tarball containing all result files
output-files.name: Output file
